subject: Prefetch failure: emergency hotfix & customer actions
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prefetch failure: emergency hotfix & customer actions

Team —

We are seeing a sudden spike in 95th/99th latency for customer inference calls that correlate with a prefetch subsystem error. Error pattern: repeated 502s from prefetch worker causing degraded tail latency and a small number of request retries. Impact window started ~08:05 PT.

Immediate plan (next 30m):
- Disable prefetch feature flag for affected fleet (rollback to sync reads only).
- Prepare an emergency hotfix (minimal change) to fix the prefetch request timeout handling — Rishi is preparing the patch.
- CS (Monica) to notify affected customers with an ETA and mitigation steps.

Please treat this as P1 — I will coordinate customer comms. Attaching the initial patch and a runbook stub.

Attachments: hotfix_prefetch_v1.patch, runbook_prefetch_fix.md

Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, monica_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2029 08:20:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Prefetch failure: emergency hotfix & customer actions

On it — quick technical summary and suggested steps.

Root cause hypothesis: malformed prefetch response in edge-worker that doesn't honor the connection close path, leaving stale in-flight state. Under load this causes the prefetch manager to retry and exhaust the worker pool, increasing latency. No evidence of data loss; only request handling errors.

Hotfix details (minimal scope):
1) Add defensive timeout guard + explicit cancel path in prefetch handler (hotfix_prefetch_v1.patch).
2) Add safety counter to avoid unlimited retries (fails closed).
3) Metrics: prefetch_failure_count and prefetch_inflight_depth added for monitoring.

Deployment plan (30m):
- Build & smoke on canary (2 machines). 10m smoke.
- If green, roll to region-us-west-2 in 2 waves (10m each) with 5m safety pause.
- If regress, immediate rollback and re-enable feature flag.

Runbook steps are attached (runbook_prefetch_fix.md).

Rishi
Staff SWE, Serving Runtime

Resolution summary and next steps —

Status: Resolved. The prefetch hotfix (hotfix_prefetch_v1.patch) was rolled to affected regions by 09:25 PT. We saw a sustained return to normal tail latency and zero prefetch failure counts. No customer data loss detected.

Follow-up actions:
- Postmortem written and initial draft shared: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PrefetchPostmortem
- We will add an automated safeguard to block prefetch retries above a configurable threshold by the next release (v1.3).
- Monica will send an official customer incident acknowledgement PDF (attached: incident_ack_acme.pdf).
- Engineering will open a ticket to add additional end-to-end tests for malformed prefetch responses.

If you want a brief postmortem call, Monica can coordinate. Thank you for the quick responses and patience.

-Aisha Rahman
